brief_en: Quiet start to Sunday 30 Aug (Taipei). No verified official announcements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, or xAI after 16:00 UTC 29 Aug. Prior-day stories (Cursor wind-down, MHS preview, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, Nvidia–Hugging Face report) stay on 28–29 Aug and are not resurfaced.
brief_zh: 台北時間 8/30 週日開盤安靜。8/29 16:00 UTC 後，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta AI、xAI 皆無已核實官方新宣布。Cursor 合約、MHS、Gemini 3.5 Transcribe、傳輝達收購 Hugging Face 等屬 28–29 日舊聞，不重掛今日。
